# facet vantage

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:facetVantage`](gmeow-facetVantage.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/facetVantage>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)

The agent asserting an identity facet — the vantage of the claim. When [`gmeow:selfAsserted`](gmeow-selfAsserted.md) is true, the [`facetVantage`](gmeow-facetVantage.md) is the person themselves ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9): self-assertion is top authority).
